item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.changes: Sharper exports: exporting bigger than your sequence (like 1080p to 4K) now upscales with Apple's MetalFX instead of stretching. One Audio menu in Export: choose No audio, As mixed, or a loudness target in one place. Linked folders: files you delete in Finder leave Media too, unless they're on your timeline. Smoother Media: click empty space to deselect, and improved drag and drop import animation.
